missing_hlg_evaluation.rationale: The project description covers supplier management, proposal evaluation, goods reception, inventory management, customer shopping, payment, delivery tracking, customer support, and business analytics. All these functional areas are represented by the current High-Level Goals (HLGs) for the identified actors. For example, 'Provide Seamless Shopping Experience' covers browsing and ordering, 'Ensure Secure and Diverse Payment Options' covers payments, 'Track Order Deliveries' covers shipment tracking, and 'Receive Timely Customer Support' covers ticket submission. The specific workflow steps (e.g., 48-hour reminders, 5-day revision windows, random shipping assignment) are implementation details or sub-goals of the existing broad stakeholder intentions. There are no distinct, documented functional intentions for any actor that are absent from the current HLG list.
